description: BlackRock, Inc. is a leading publicly traded investment management firm with $14.0 trillion of assets under management at December 31, 2025 and approximately 24,900 employees in more than 30 countries serving clients in over 100 countries across the globe, providing a broad range of investment management and technology and subscription services to institutional and retail clients worldwide. On July 1, 2025 it completed the acquisition of 100 percent of the business and assets of HPS Investment Partners, a leading global credit investment manager, and concurrently BlackRock Finance, Inc., Global Infrastructure Management and HPS and their respective subsidiaries became wholly owned subsidiaries of BlackRock Saturn Subco, LLC. It attributes its ability to increase revenue, earnings and stockholder value over time to generating new business, including business in Aladdin and other technology products and services, and considers its ability to attract, develop and retain qualified professionals critical to that effort.
